elements.name: Open the full navigation wheel and close it from its menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software
the viewport navigation bar is visible
the full navigation wheel is the selected wheel layout
the user opens the navigation wheel from the navigation bar
the user clicks within the viewport
a circular navigation wheel is visible over the model
the wheel offers Zoom, Orbit, Pan, Rewind, Center, Walk, Look and Up Down
the user right-clicks the navigation wheel
its menu marks Full Navigation Wheel as selected
the menu offers alternate mini and basic wheel layouts
the menu offers Go Home, Fit to Window, Restore Original Center, Options and Close Wheel
the user chooses Close Wheel
the wheel and its menu disappear
the model remains visible in the same apparent view
the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Switch between the basic wheel layouts

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open over a visible model in the MCAD Software
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Basic View Object Wheel
the wheel shows Center, Zoom, Rewind and Orbit controls
the user right-clicks the wheel
Basic View Object Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Basic Tour Building Wheel
the wheel shows Forward, Look, Rewind and Up Down controls
the user right-clicks the wheel
Basic Tour Building Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel
the user presses Escape
the wheel disappears
the model remains visible in the same apparent view
the status area displays Ready
`fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open over a visible model in the MCAD Software
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini View Object Wheel
a small segmented circular wheel appears
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini Tour Building Wheel
a small segmented circular wheel remains visible
the user right-clicks the wheel
Mini Tour Building Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Mini Full Navigation Wheel
a small circular wheel with more segments appears
the user right-clicks the wheel
Mini Full Navigation Wheel is marked as the selected layout
the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel
the user presses Escape
the wheel disappears
the model remains visible in the same apparent view
the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Cancel a mini wheel size preference change

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open over a model in the MCAD Software
the saved mini wheel size is Normal
the user opens Options from the wheel context menu
the dialog shows tool message and tool tip controls
it shows mini wheel size, big wheel size and wheel opacity controls
it shows navigation options and a walk speed factor slider
the user opens the mini wheel size list
it offers Small, Normal, Large and Extra Large
the user chooses Extra Large
the mini wheel size field displays Extra Large
OK is enabled
the user clicks Cancel
the user reopens Options from the wheel context menu
the mini wheel size field displays Normal
the user clicks Cancel and presses Escape
the options dialog and wheel are closed
`fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the navigation wheel options dialog is open in the MCAD Software
the user opens the big wheel size list
it offers Small, Normal and Large
the user dismisses that list and opens the wheel opacity list
it offers 25%, 50%, 75% and 90%
the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel
the options dialog closes and the navigation wheel remains visible

elements.name: Apply and restore the big wheel size

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is visible in the MCAD Software
its big wheel size preference is Normal
the user opens the wheel options and chooses Large for big wheel size
the user clicks OK
the options dialog closes
the full wheel appears larger than before
the user reopens wheel options
the big wheel size field displays Large
the user chooses Normal for big wheel size and clicks OK
the full wheel returns to its previous apparent size
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes

elements.name: Fit a small model from the wheel menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a single rectangular block appears small in an active part in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Fit to Window
the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport
the wheel remains open
the same part and orientation remain active
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Return to the home view from the wheel menu

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software
the home view has a known three-face orientation
the current view differs from the home view
the full navigation wheel is open
the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Go Home
the block returns to the known home orientation
the navigation wheel remains open
the same part remains active
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
`fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open in the MCAD Software
its wheel opacity preference is 50%
the user opens the wheel options and chooses 90% wheel opacity
the user clicks OK
the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible
the user reopens the wheel options
the wheel opacity field displays 90%
the user chooses 50% wheel opacity and clicks OK
the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Apply and restore the mini wheel size

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the Mini View Object Wheel is open in the MCAD Software
the mini wheel size preference is Normal
the user opens wheel options and chooses Extra Large for mini wheel size
the user clicks OK
the options dialog closes
the mini wheel appears larger than before
the user reopens wheel options
the mini wheel size field displays Extra Large
the user chooses Normal for mini wheel size and clicks OK
the mini wheel returns to its earlier apparent size
the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel from the wheel menu
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
`fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel is open in the MCAD Software
Show Tool Tips is enabled in wheel options
the user opens wheel options and clear Show Tool Tips
the user clicks OK
the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible
the user reopens wheel options
Show Tool Tips is unchecked
the user selects Show Tool Tips and clicks OK
the options dialog closes and the wheel remains visible
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready

elements.name: Repeat the last navigation wheel command

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/main-window-frame-start.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a rectangular block is visible in an active part in the MCAD Software
the full navigation wheel was the last command used
the wheel is closed
the user right-clicks the model viewport
the context menu offers to repeat the navigation wheel command
the user chooses the repeat navigation wheel command
the full navigation wheel appears over the model
the same part remains active
the user presses Escape
the wheel closes and the status area displays Ready
